CROSS_SOURCE_VALIDATION_FAIL.triage_instructions: Confirm the conflicting source values, document the authoritative source, and either mark false positive or remediate the bad record.

SYSTEMATIC_DISAGREEMENT.triage_instructions: Investigate sustained cross-source divergence, identify the venue or parser issue, and leave a resolution note before unblocking.

CORPORATE_ACTION_REQUIRED_FIELDS.triage_instructions: Backfill the missing economic fields, confirm the authoritative corporate action payload, then resolve as remediated to trigger reprocess.

CORPORATE_ACTION_UNMATCHED.triage_instructions: Check both exchange feeds for the missing action, confirm whether the event is real, and remediate or mark false positive with evidence.

CORPORATE_ACTION_SOURCE_GAP.triage_instructions: Investigate source coverage gaps, verify the canonical event details, and queue replay only after the source gap is resolved.

CORPORATE_ACTION_TYPE_FAIL.triage_instructions: Compare both exchange announcements, identify the correct action type, and remediate the wrong event mapping before reprocessing.

CORPORATE_ACTION_TYPE_MISMATCH.triage_instructions: Resolve the authoritative action type across sources and document the rationale prior to replay.

CORPORATE_ACTION_PARAMETER_MISMATCH.triage_instructions: Validate the economic parameters against the exchange notices and remediate the adjustment inputs before replay.

CORPORATE_ACTION_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK.triage_instructions: Triage within one business day. Confirm whether the nearby candidate represents the same event, then resolve as false positive or escalate into a blocking corporate-action review.

DISCONTINUITY_REVIEW.triage_instructions: Review the discontinuity context, confirm whether a corporate action or data issue explains the move, and escalate only when the move indicates a broader publication risk.
